sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (see Policy Schedule)

room_rent.note: Base policy has no room rent cap. Optional 'Room Rent limit' add-on caps at 1% of SI or ₹5,000/day (whichever lower).

icu.note: Optional 'Room Rent limit' add-on caps ICU at 2% of SI or ₹7,500/day (whichever lower).

sub_limits.display: Cataract optional cap; domiciliary 10% of SI
sub_limits.note: Domiciliary capped at 10% of Basic SI. Optional Cataract Capping and Modern Surgeries add-ons available.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting 36 or 24 months per plan schedule. Elite plan qualifies for optional 'PED Protector' (age ≤50): after 2 completed years coverage limited to 30% of SI or ₹2L; after 3 completed years full SI coverage.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Same tiered waiting periods as other variants.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Code Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: Inbuilt Loyalty Perk: 10%/yr up to 100%. Optional Super Booster: 50%/yr up to 150%.

restoration.note: Optional 'Reload of Sum Insured' add-on waives same-illness restriction.

notable_exclusions: Maternity (excl. ectopic), STDs/HIV, dental (non-accidental), external congenital anomaly, OPD treatment, treatment outside India (unless Global Cover add-on), self-inflicted injury
optional_riders: Zero Deduct, Vector Borne Disease, Super Booster (CB up to 150%), EMI Protector, PED Protector (Diabetes & HTN), Global Cover, Domestic Travel Plus, Reload of SI, Co-Pay, Modern Surgeries, Cataract Capping, Room Rent limit
